description: Ergonomic Wireless Rechargeable Mouse Amkette Hush Pro Spectra is a wireless mouse with the latest Ergonomic design that connects with the 2.4G Wireless technology via a USB Nano receiver. The wireless connection virtually eliminates delays, dropouts, and interference, offering a no-lag experience. *This Amkette Hush Pro Spectra Rechargeable Wireless Mouse, Black is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Silent Switches with 5 Color LED Lights The Mouse is equipped with Silent switches for noiseless operation and 5 color lights to create an extraordinary presence on your workstation. The Slim and Sleek design makes you love the presence of this mouse in your hand for long and extensive use. *This Amkette Hush Pro Spectra Rechargeable Wireless Mouse, Black is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Adjustable DPI Level The Mouse offers Adjustable DPI settings of 800-1200-1600 DPI using a DPI button. The Intelligent Auto Sleep function in the mouse on 3 mins of inactivity along with the power On/Off button makes it the perfect solution for your everyday use. *This Amkette Hush Pro Spectra Rechargeable Wireless Mouse, Black is for illustration purpose only
